Well, you’re a stranger! If not you, then who? Oh, my poor little girl….

Well, $NAME, are you the kind of traveller who fancies adventure? The kind that relishes a challenge? That finds their thrills exploring ancient ruins for lost treasures? If so, I’ve got a job for you - and I’ll pay you as well!
Not far from here lies the ruins of a great manor. Stories go the house is over five hundred years old!

1.text: Supposed to have belonged to the legendary scholar Sara Lucian, who’s botanical exploration lead to the colonization of this here wilderness.

2.text: I’m a historian by trade, and I’m busy trying to compile a book on the ancient scholar. If you could have a bit of an exploration of his ruined estate and bring back some evidence of his being there, I’d pay you a princely sum!

0.text: Great, you looked like the sort of traveller I can trust. Head to the North East of Hulthine’s Vale, there sits the abandoned estate, find me some evidence he once lived there.

This is the estate of the famed Hulthine nobility. Though, it’s definitely seen better days. Once the most important noble family in all Patreayl, they’re now all but a memory on the pages of history.

1.text: Ever since young Oscar killed his father, Lady Hulthine’s been a state. If you don’t believe me, go see her for yourself. Such a shame. Yet another noble house destroyed by infighting and bigotry...
